title.narrative: Build the autonomy and independence of people with disabilities using life skills and economic development tools, promote inclusive economic educational and social programs that support the rights of people with disabilities

description.narrative: People with disabilities in Bolivia face a number of economic and social barriers to fully participating in and contributing to society. The challenges for children and youth with disabilities are even greater. The IAF supports community-led solutions to create opportunities for people with disabilities. Our grantee Fundacin Escuela de Integracin Formacin Deportiva Expresin Artstica y Desarrollo Laboral (EIFODEC) is an association dedicated to promoting economic and social inclusion and respect for the rights of people with disabilities especially children and young people in Cochabamba and nationally. EIFODEC is building the autonomy and independence of people with disabilities using life skills and economic development tools that EIFODEC and other organizations can adapt and scale up. It is also investing in its own capacity to raise funds and engage partners to promote inclusive economic educational and social programs that support the rights of people with disabilities in Bolivia.
